at_sea:
CLOSED THIS SESSION: ticket 2f0a6ea8c966-a-beat-costs-what-changed is PROVED (crossings BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME -> PROVED, all through harbor_master.clearance.clear, journalled in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/history.json). It is the FIRST ticket in the corpus with a 'to: PROVED' crossing record. Akien's red on 2026-09-07 was 'i can't imagine why we should need to parse all class space every 60 seconds'; the beat was 104.8s against a 60s cadence and is 23.7s steady state now, over four fixes: 42c9e15 (chart-chain packet index — 1,568 store sweeps a beat down to one), 11d2ec0 (once() plus _pulse, for a pulse context nothing had ever populated), e53a973 (settled(), keyed on a (path, mtime_ns, size) tree fingerprint), af50ab8 (the 'context or {}' that had every shim swapping out the beat's own dict). A/B: 78 probes compared, 0 answered differently. ground_loop: 9 proofs, 9 green, 0 red, sealed. Both repos pushed — cairn 38483e7, CairnCommons 49767c5.

HIS RULING 2026-09-08: '60s cadence is right, close it out.' Berthed at CairnCommons/decisions/2026-09-08-the-60s-cadence-is-the-bound-a-beat-is-measured-against.json. The ticket had been cast against a 1.0s cadence he himself superseded on 2026-08-22 (cairn 6ae83e7, which he authored), so clause one demanded a bound that had not been the bound for two weeks.
next_direction: The trouble beat-tail-re-walks-corpora-no-sieve-counts stays LIVE and is the next work: 23.5 of every 23.7 seconds is still corpora re-walked that did not move — the SAME defect at ~78 addresses instead of the original three. Each probe walks tickets/, reads history.json, or shells git on its own account, once per beat, forever. settled() is the pattern that fits and none of them is wired to it. Critically, NOTHING WOULD RED THE 79TH PROBE THAT ALSO IS NOT, so the tail grows back by construction (Law 1). The missing piece is a sieve that counts unmemoized corpus walks. Child B, the-beat-does-not-dial-the-database, is still never cast: inference_domain, 975 json loads and 32 psycopg2 round trips per beat.
open_threads:
1. THE PLACEHOLDER CHART CHAINS — a measurement worth Akien's eye, not yet a cast ticket. 54 of 322 validate berths in ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets carry criteria reading 'NOT IN THIS DATA VERSION YET' (a 2026-08-26 backfill). 2f0a6ea8c966's whole chain is one, and its hypothesize berth's triage_ref points at a packet claiming a DIFFERENT ticket (a-claim-carries-its-provenance) — the chain below it does not hold. The PROVED exit gate demands a verdict answering the CLAIMING berth (inspector.py:2118 refuses the falsifier@ form), so the only honest shapes are: echo the placeholder claim and put the real substance in instrument/evidence/discriminating_observation (what I did, following verdict-20260827T190145-a3bc22b83115 from 2026-08-27), or re-run all seven chart stages for a build already finished. MY READ, not ratified: every future PROVED crossing on those 54 hits this same wall.

2. FALSIFIER NUMBERING IS A TRAP, caught by instrument not by reading. verdict.falsifier_criteria segments on ANY parenthesised numeral, so a falsifier citing its own clauses back by number is unsegmentable and refuses outright — which means a WATCHME probe that can never file a verdict. My first amendment did exactly this (nine markers where there are four). Fixed for this ticket; NOT swept for the corpus. Nothing warns an author.

3. A CROSSING MUST LAND ON COMMITTED STATE and nothing says so. The PROVEME crossing journals into the component's history.json and state.json, and the next crossing's build gate runs working_tree_clean over that same subtree — so crossing N's journal is dirt to crossing N+1's gate. A script firing three crossings in one process cannot commit between them and reds itself at the second door. Learned by refusal.

4. Ticket ffc775a09d54's own falsifier still spells 1.0s and is stale the same way this one was. Noted in the sibling probe's docstring; not fixed — different ticket.

5. Carried, unchanged: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_validation_store.py takes ~500s and cannot seal at the 120s default. 16 live troubles in the session-open banner. 196 PROVED tickets still carry no crossings record.
